'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***An overnight [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[Shahed drones|Shahed drone]] strike kills five people, including a child, and injures nine others in [[Pryluky]], [[Chernihiv Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-strikes-trump-putin-950b9b293dfb53b0da938275e5f3f3a3 (AP)]
***A Russian [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] injures nineteen people in [[Kharkiv]], including children and a pregnant woman. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-war-strikes-trump-putin-950b9b293dfb53b0da938275e5f3f3a3 (AP)]
**[[Kherson strikes (2022–present)|Kherson strikes]]
***The [[Kherson]] Regional State Administration headquarters is destroyed in a Russian [[missile]] strike. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/4001176-zelensky-strikes-on-kherson-administration-had-no-military-purpose.html (Ukrinform)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***Israeli forces in Gaza recover the bodies of an [[American-Israeli]] couple abducted by militants during the [[October 7 attacks]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/gaza/israeli-forces-recover-bodies-2-hostages-us-citizenship-held-gaza-rcna211109 (NBC News)]
**[[Rafah aid distribution killings]]
***A [[CNN]] investigation points to the [[Israel Defense Forces]] opening fire on crowds of [[Palestinian]]s as they tried to get [[humanitarian aid]] in [[Rafah]], [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/06/04/middleeast/israel-military-gaza-aid-shooting-intl-invs (CNN)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[Israeli Air Force]] jets launch [[airstrike]]s on southern [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]], targeting alleged underground [[Hezbollah]] drone manufacturing facilities. [https://www.turkiyetoday.com/region/massive-explosions-reported-in-southern-beirut-following-israeli-airstrikes-3202454 (Türkiye Today)] [https://www.al-monitor.com/originals/2025/06/israel-strikes-beirut-targeting-underground-hezbollah-drone-facilities (Al-Monitor)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Chad–United States relations]]
**[[Chad]] suspends the issuance of [[Visa policy of Chad|visas]] to [[U.S. citizen]]s in response to a new [[Trump travel ban|travel ban]] announced by [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]], that includes Chad among twelve countries facing entry restrictions. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cyvm2j32pvmo (BBC News)]
*[[Mexico–United States relations]], [[Gun law in the United States]]
**The [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]] unanimously blocks a 10-billion dollar lawsuit by the [[Federal government of Mexico|Mexican government]] against [[List of modern armament manufacturers|large American firearms manufacturers]] alleging their failure to prevent firearms sales to [[drug cartel]]s and other criminal organisations due to a lack of evidence that the companies allow such transactions. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/5/supreme-court-strikes-down-mexicos-lawsuit-against-us-gun-manufacturers (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/supreme-court-guns-mexico-737f69a7447647e13b49a2b1a7c72c57 (AP)] [https://www.politico.com/news/2025/06/05/supreme-court-mexico-gun-lawsuit-00389108 (''Politico'')]
*[[United States and the International Criminal Court]]
**The United States imposes sanctions on 4 ICC judges in retaliation over the war tribunal's issuance of an arrest warrant for [[Israeli prime minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] and a past decision to open a case into alleged [[war crimes]] by [[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|U.S. troops in Afghanistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-administration-imposes-sanctions-icc-judges-us-treasury-says-2025-06-05/ (Reuters)]
